undeclared.decision: Corpus inclusion additionally requires quaternion norms within 0.05 of unity, bounded shoulder width and finger-bone lengths, a nondegenerate palm, and at least 101 resampled frames. Positions and quaternion components receive Gaussian smoothing with sigma 0.8.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-002 declares annotation filtering and interpolation but not these additional rejection and smoothing rules. They change which motions survive and the motion represented by a reference.

undeclared.decision: Workspace mapping assumes global Z is up, derives torso yaw from horizontally projected shoulders, removes shoulder-midpoint translation independently at every frame, and scales fingertip-center and wrist displacement by a fixed factor of 1.12.
undeclared.why_it_matters: These choices define the mapped target and its reachability. A-004 describes torso anchoring and robot-scaled fingers without declaring this workspace scaling or removal of torso motion.

undeclared.decision: Each extracted segment calibrates fingertip orientation using its first frame: mapped rotation includes source_rot(t) @ source_rot(0).T @ human_distal(0) @ site_frame.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The orientation target preserves source rotation changes after a segment-specific alignment. Its initial absolute orientation is reconstructed from bone geometry and robot site frames. This affects the meaning and comparability of mapped-to-projected orientation errors.

undeclared.decision: Training resets sample uniformly over concatenated reference frames, initialize both reference q and qdot at the sampled phase, and ramp reset noise over 6,000 environment control steps.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Longer retained motions receive more sampling weight, and training teaches recovery from reference-phase states rather than always tracking complete clips from their starts. A-005 permits reference initialization but does not declare this distribution or curriculum.

undeclared.decision: Tracking failure uses the worst hand's fingertip-centroid displacement exceeding 0.20 m; completion means reaching the reference end without failure flags. Individual tip, orientation and shape errors do not independently prevent completion.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Completion is a survival-to-end measure, not a thresholded full-hand tracking success measure. Centroid averaging can cancel individual fingertip errors. These semantics are absent from A-007/A-010.

undeclared.decision: Reference admission computes fingertip P95 over per-frame means across ten fingertips, whereas policy evaluation computes P95 over pooled time-by-fingertip errors.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The two identically named P95 statistics have different statistical units. A-008's 85 mm admission threshold cannot be interpreted as the same percentile reported by evaluation.

undeclared.decision: Unavailable perturbed/alternate starts are excluded from completion denominators. Alternate eligibility requires at least 10 mm displacement of the more displaced elbow while retaining wrist tolerances. Error summaries exclude partial safety-failure intervals and report completed clips or observed prefixes; episode_macro_tip_mm uses only completed clips, including completed subsets of otherwise incomplete episodes.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Conditions can have different eligible populations and observed durations. The episode macro tip statistic is conditional on completion and is not an error over all attempted episode motion. A-007 does not declare these selection and censoring rules.

undeclared.decision: Training's holdout/* diagnostics reserve simulator environment indices while all environments draw references from the same supplied training library.
undeclared.why_it_matters: These are transition holdout diagnostics within the training motion corpus, distinct from the episode-disjoint validation/test split in A-001. Their names must not be interpreted as held-out source-episode performance.

stale_rows.declared: Evaluate complete and failed clips and aggregate by source episode.
stale_rows.actual: Episode counts and a completed-clip fingertip macro mean are provided, but completion, reward, orientation, cross-tip geometry, shape and observed-prefix summaries remain clip-weighted. Failed-clip errors are not aggregated by episode.
stale_rows.why_it_matters: Episodes contributing more retained clips still receive greater weight in most reported outcomes. Either complete the stated episode aggregation or narrow the ledger claim explicitly.

resweep.scope: Read-only review of the current local sources and ledger; no runtime, GPU, or physics-parity validation.
